workarea-persistence-no-world: Work area coordinates cannot be saved because this world's identity is unavailable.
workarea-persistence-unsupported: The saved work area file uses an unsupported format. It has not been overwritten; work area edits remain unsaved until the file is repaired.
workarea-persistence-invalid-entry: This world's saved work area is invalid and was not loaded. Set an endpoint to replace this world's entry.
workarea-persistence-load-failed: The saved work area file could not be read. It has not been overwritten; check the game log.
workarea-persistence-save-failed: Work area coordinates could not be saved and may be lost after restart. The next endpoint edit or world exit will retry.
workarea-persistence-cleanup-failed: A temporary work area config file could not be removed. Check the game log.
workarea-create: Work area: left-click terrain to create the missing endpoint(s). Right-click or Escape cancels.
workarea-aim-at-block: Work area: target loaded terrain within the camera view.
workarea-drag-unavailable: This work area handle cannot follow the current viewing angle safely. Adjust your view and try again.
workarea-invalid-endpoint: That work area position is outside valid coordinates or belongs to another dimension.
workarea-invalid-size: Enter a positive whole-block size that keeps the work area within valid world coordinates.
workarea-dimension-mismatch: The work area belongs to another dimension. Return there to see and edit it.
workarea-render-unavailable: The work area wireframe is unavailable for this world session. Sizes still work; check the game log.
gizmo-render-unavailable: In-world editing controls are unavailable for this world session. Measurements and saved values still work; check the game log.
gizmo-input-unavailable: In-world editing input is unavailable for this world session. Measurements and saved values still work; check the game log.
build-info-workarea-invalid-name: Enter a name of 1 to {0} characters, without control characters.
build-info-workarea-duplicate-name: A work area already has that name.
build-info-workarea-delete-confirm: Delete work area "{0}"? This cannot be undone.
itemdesc-buildhammer-*: A keepsake wooden hammer. Build mode is available through its configurable hotkey.
